item.title: Upcoming plans help Murph stay relevant
item.summary: One morning check updates Journal and brings useful travel and life context into private conversations and reminders.
item.details: Active calendar and email connections participate without an extra setup step, while opt-outs and disconnections remain respected. Murph can suggest practical preparations when an upcoming plan matters to your question, even if you do not mention it. Plan corrections and all-day dates carry through to private context, and expired plans drop out. Journal updates and follow-ups remain, and your reminder schedules and experiment plans stay under your control.
